query:
SELECT
            u.id,
            u.email::text AS "email!",
            u.role AS "role: Role",
            (
                LEAST(
                    now() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                    s.created_at + make_interval(secs => $3)
                ) > s.expires_at
                AND (
                    LEAST(
                        now() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                        s.created_at + make_interval(secs => $3)
                    ) >= s.expires_at + make_interval(secs => $4)
                    OR LEAST(
                        now() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                        s.created_at + make_interval(secs => $3)
                    ) = s.created_at + make_interval(secs => $3)
                )
            ) AS "needs_refresh!"
        FROM sessions s
        JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id
        WHERE s.token_hash = $1
          AND s.expires_at > now()
